biography.value:
Published alignment: LE/LN.

Description

Scales the color of emerald armor this wyrmling dragon with multiple horns pointed behind atop of its head.

Defense

AC 22, touch 20, flat-footed 13 (+8 dex, +2 natural, +1 dodge, +1 size)

hp 63 (7d12+7)

mp 21

Fort +6, Ref +13, Will +10

Immune Wind, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Earth 50%

Weakness Ice

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)

Melee Bite +8 (1d6+1), 2 Claws +8 (1d4+1)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (20-ft. cone, 2d10 wind damage, Reflex DC 14 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Engulfing Winds

Special Abilities White Wind

Spells Known (FC CL 7th, Concentration +8)

At will - detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 12) - alter winds, choco feather, wind armor, wind runner, wind shield

2nd (DC 13) - elemental resistance, float, whisper wind, wind barrier

Statistics

Str 12, Dex 26, Con 12, Int 8, Wis 16, Cha 10

Base Atk +7; CMB +7; CMD 26 (30 vs. trip)

Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack

Skills Fly +28, Perception +11, Spellcraft +9, Stealth +22, Survival +11; Racial Modifiers +8 Fly

Languages Draconic

description.value: A green dragon's sight is not impeded by clouds or fog, or by spells that create areas of fog.

As a standard action, a green dragon can launch a gust of wind that engulfs their enemy within 30 feet for 4d4 points of wind damage and is inflicted with the Squalled status for 1d4 rounds. The target of this ability must make a Fortitude save (DC 16) to reduce the damage by half and negate the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 17).
